harness_intro: A Playwright harness ([`tools/harness.mts`]({TREE}/tools/harness.mts), specs in [`tools/specs.mts`]({TREE}/tools/specs.mts)) mounts each changed call site for real: the running app (production `next build`, signed-in admin, the 17 store agents and `make test-data`) or a story that renders the real component, built into each commit's Storybook ([evidence stories]({TREE}/tools/evstories), never committed; the builder data they replay is a recorded live response). Before every shot it asserts the changed element is visible, and every keyboard step is asserted: a miss fails the capture and the run. Determinism is fixed at the source: 1440x900 and 390x844 at scale 1, DS1's software-raster flags plus `--hide-scrollbars`, UTC/en-US, story clocks starting at 2026-01-15 12:00 UTC, the backend's diagnostics `timestamp` fields pinned to that instant, the changelog feed blocked, one sign-in per run (signing in per capture trips the auth rate limit and the page renders signed out), finite animations run to their end, infinite CSS animations stopped at their first frame, and a shot only once three frames 750ms apart are identical. Base and head run the same specs; the gate ([`hcompare.py`]({TREE}/tools/hcompare.py)) needs every screenshot identical at threshold 0, every check passing on both and every observed behaviour equal. The seeded test data's timestamps are shifted 22 days 3h47m back before the runs (one `UPDATE` over the `platform` schema's timestamp columns, auth tables excluded, [`pipeline3.sh`]({TREE}/tools/pipeline3.sh)), so every relative label ("23d ago" on the workflow page, "about 23 days" in the admin table) reads the same for the whole capture window; a first round taken before the shift showed "21h ago" against "22h ago" and was discarded whole, and every run below was taken after it.

text_first.1: `molecules/PaginationControls`' page label is `<Text variant="body-tight" tone="inherit" as="span">` with no className: `body-tight` (`font-sans text-body font-normal leading-5`, DS7-1 #16134's string) carries the 14px/20px the span had, and the `inherit` tone keeps the colour it inherited (`foreground` #09090B, where Text's default is `foreground-base` #141414). `font-sans` and `font-normal` equal what the label inherits on both admin pages (table 2).
text_first.2: No new text element. `atoms/Calendar` passes `className="w-[120px] space-x-2 bg-surface text-body leading-5"` to the select primitives' `SelectTrigger` (its month/year dropdown), kept from the legacy calendar with `text-sm` → `text-body leading-5` and `bg-white` → `bg-surface` (table 2).
text_first.3: `molecules/MultiSelect`'s chip label is `<Text variant="small-semibold-tight" tone="inherit" as="span">` with no className: the new `small-semibold-tight` variant (`font-sans text-caption font-semibold leading-4`, `TODO(tokens)`: no role is 12px/16px at 600) carries the 12px/16px and the 600 weight the span inherited from the legacy badge, and the `inherit` tone keeps the badge's colour (table 2).

found: (1) With `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, the app sidebar's items can stay blurred: the server renders the full-motion initial style (`filter: blur(4px)`), and once framer reads the preference it switches to an opacity-only variant that never animates the blur away; whether a page hits it depends on whether its sidebar was server-rendered. The harness runs with no motion preference so the entrance animation completes; reported to the orchestrator for the sidebar's owner, not changed here. (2) On `/admin/marketplace` (a server-rendered page), Next's client router sometimes keeps page 2 after Previous asks for page 1, although the request returns 200, by mouse and by keyboard, on `dev` as on this branch; a fresh load of `?page=1` is fine. The harness asserts what the control owns (Enter on Previous requests `?page=1`) and loads the last page directly. (3) The builder's control-panel triggers (Blocks, Save) are a `div role=button` with `tabIndex=-1`, so Tab never reaches them on `dev` or on this stack; the harness records this on both sides, opens the popover by click and asserts Escape and an outside click close it. (4) `/login`, `/signup` and `/copilot` redirect when signed in (`/copilot` also signed out); the harness captures the auth pages signed out and does not count `/copilot`. (5) After Escape closes the builder's Save popover, focus lands on `body`, not back on its trigger (the Blocks popover returns it to its trigger); the same on `dev` and on this stack.
